_doc: Sources for this region. 'adapter' names a module in scripts/adapters; platform adapters (reclub, aces, daysmart) take their venues/pages from 'options'. region and timezone come from region.json; sport from 'defaults' unless a source sets its own. 'cadence' is how often a source is scraped (30m, 1h, 6h, 1d; default 30m): the scrape clock ticks every 30 minutes by day and hourly overnight, and each tick runs only the sources that are due. Add a venue on an existing platform here; a new platform needs an adapter in scripts/adapters and a line in lib/registry.js.

discover._doc: Weekly discovery of DFW volleyball clubs on Reclub not in clubs (scripts/discover-reclub.mjs); same rules as Austin's.
queries: site:reclub.co volleyball Plano OR Frisco OR Richardson
site:reclub.co volleyball Irving OR Arlington OR Carrollton
